findings.description: Four shapes leave the decoder waiting with no upstream contact and no status — a `0` terminator without its final CRLF, an over-declared size with the terminator following, a bare `\r` terminator, and the same three on a keep-alive socket. The socket then closes with zero bytes at `header_timeout` (1.00 s measured with `header_timeout_ms=1000`, i.e. 20x sooner than `idle_timeout_ms=20000` implied). 64 of these concurrently fill `maxconn` and the 65th connection is reset. All 36 accepted shapes re-emit an honest `Content-Length` equal to the emitted byte count, so this is not a smuggle.
findings.title: Stalled chunked bodies hold their connection slot past the header deadline, and 64 of them reset the 65th client

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
